component.name: Elevate
component.summary: Modern, modular digital audio workstation built with Rust and GPUI

description.p: Elevate is a fast, keyboard-driven digital audio workstation (DAW) designed for fluid music production, recording, and sequencing.

ul.li: High-performance vector user interface powered by GPUI.
Modular audio architecture with built-in sampler (sfizz SFZ engine) and SoundFont synth support.
Precision piano roll with modal editing, humanization, and scale snapping.
Flexible track routing with integrated serial/parallel FX chains.
Extensible via Lua scripting for MIDI transformations and workflows.

description.p: Initial Flatpak preview release featuring GPUI interface, sfizz sampler, and SoundFont playback.
